quantifier_review.registration: J and its finite registration, row : J -> PMF X, N : J -> Nat, and rho : J -> Real are fixed inputs independent of omega. hN is forall j, 0 < N j; hrho is forall j, 0 <= rho j.
quantifier_review.sample_type: sample : forall j, Fin (N j) -> Omega -> X
quantifier_review.common_experiment: One probability measure mu is used in every measurability, row-independence and marginal-law premise; hlaw states mu.map (sample j k) = (row j).toMeasure for every j,k.
quantifier_review.independence: hindep requires iIndepFun (sample j) mu separately for each row. No independence between different rows is assumed by registered_row_calibration.
quantifier_review.joint_event: Exists one measurable good subset of Omega whose complement has probability at most confidenceBudget X N rho, and forall omega in good, forall j, the empirical row TV error is at most rho j.
quantifier_review.budget: Sum over j of card(Finset X) * (2 * exp(-2 * N j * (rho j)^2)); the existing single-row calibration is reused with Unit, followed only by a finite union bound. No new concentration inequality or minimum-count replacement is assumed.
quantifier_review.real_product_experiment: Coordinates are Sigma j, Fin (N j). productRowLaw is the product of the corresponding row PMF measures; coordinate evaluation supplies actual measurability, row independence and the same-law marginals before applying registered_row_calibration.
quantifier_review.empty_registration: No Nonempty J premise occurs. If J is empty, hN and all row requirements are vacuous, the intersection is univ, the sum budget is zero, and the product coordinate domain is empty, giving the probability law on its singleton function space. The theorem remains valid.
retained_limits: Does not justify data-dependent sample counts, stopping times or data-dependent radii.
Does not yet connect row-specific radii to the production time-indexed deployment budget or prove a new adaptive selection risk endpoint.
Does not change the production uniform Fin N registration API.
